title: Labour Welfare Wing
chapter: Chapter VI — Labour Welfare Wing and Agreements on Migration
text: Labour Welfare Wing.— If it is deemed necessary to establish a Labour Welfare Wing in any country for the purpose of expanding reach into the labour market thereto or for protecting the rights of migrant workers, the Government may establish a Labour Welfare Wing in the Bangladesh Mission in the concerned foreign country, and the Wing shall perform duties as have been specified in this Act and the Rules thereof.
source: Overseas Employment and Migrants Act 2013 (official English translation)
